name: Wear OS Health Services Data Types 2026
methodology: Every DataType companion constant on Google's Jetpack reference for androidx.health.services.client.data.DataType (https://developer.android.com/reference/kotlin/androidx/health/services/client/data/DataType), read on 2026-10-04, joined to the permissions table in Google's Health Services permissions guide (https://developer.android.com/health-and-fitness/health-services/permissions). Name, declared Kotlin type, description and the "Added in" label are copied from the reference; dataTypeClass, valueType and dataPointClass are read from the declared type printed in kotlinType. The permission column is set only where Google's permissions table names the constant, and that table row is published beside it in permissionEvidence; both are null otherwise, never inferred from a similar name.

fields.name: The DataType companion constant
fields.kotlinType: The declared type exactly as Google prints it
fields.dataTypeClass: DeltaDataType or AggregateDataType, read from kotlinType
fields.valueType: The first type argument of kotlinType
fields.dataPointClass: The data point class kotlinType names
fields.permission: The permission Google's permissions table lists the constant under; null where the table does not name it
fields.permissionEvidence: The permissions-table row the permission was read from
fields.addedIn: The constant's own "Added in" label; null where its block prints none
fields.deprecated: yes when the reference marks the constant deprecated
fields.googleDocs: Google's reference anchor for the constant
fields.page: This site's row for the data type
